strings: In the early hours of the morning, m_c slinks in to see r_c0 to complain about sleep paralysis.
m_c softly admits to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} denmates that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} been seeing things {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} can't easily explain.
m_c sometimes wakes up unable to move fully until several blinks.
